greet.speaker: Cave Guard
greet.text: The cave beyond is dangerous. Are you prepared?

choices.text: The hermit warned me. I'm ready.

let_through.speaker: Cave Guard
let_through.text: Good. Then go — and watch yourself.

let_through_unwarned.speaker: Cave Guard
let_through_unwarned.text: Hmph. Suit yourself. Don't say I didn't warn you.
